'''Alekam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|Jedi combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]], Alekam was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], and wore brown and gold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] under brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]].<ref name="TOR" />
